title: Collect dsregcmd join status on pending user affinity
description: Runs dsregcmd /status the moment the agent reports that the signed-in user still has no Entra user token (entra_user_affinity_pending), capturing the device join and registration state at exactly the point where ANALYZE-ID-004 draws its evidence. Complements GATHER-DEVICE-001 (snapshot on entering Account Setup). Note: the agent runs as SYSTEM, so the output shows device join state — the per-user SSO/PRT state still requires running dsregcmd as the signed-in user.
author: Autopilot Monitor
